acceptanceCriteria: A test.fail test whose defect step fails yields defect-confirmed, never witnessed.
An ordinary obligation inside a test.fail test is reported MIXED_EXPECTED_FAIL with the remedy.
A run with all tests passed but a failed post-check credits nothing and names the failing check line.
Spec requirements recorded and owner-accepted; focused tests trace them; #712 answered on the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#712. The native obligation ledger (#680, shipped #697) credits an obligation when its Playwright test/step passes at retry 0. Unmodelled: (1) expected failures: a test.fail test whose obligation step fails with an error naming a defect id should record defect-confirmed, never witnessed; ordinary obligations inside a test.fail test should be reported MIXED_EXPECTED_FAIL with the remedy. (2) post-checks: witness --from-playwright-report should accept --post-check <log> --post-check-status <exit> (or a sidecar) and refuse to credit any obligation from a run whose post-check failed, quoting the first actionable line.
title: GH #712: obligations expected-fail (test.fail) outcome and post-check-aware crediting
